- If sentiment is positive (≥0.0) in recent days, model tends to overestimate; reduce forecast slightly.
- If sentiment is consistently negative (≤ -0.1) over 5+ days, model underestimates; add 0.5–1.0 to forecast.
- Overshoots after sharp upward spikes (e.g., +0.23 sentiment) are common; cap forecast at 1–2% below true peak.
- Model often lags 1–3 days in capturing sentiment-driven momentum; adjust forecast 1–2 days ahead by +0.3–0.8.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >1.5σ above recent 7-day average, reduce by 0.5–1.0.
- For 30-day horizon, avoid over-optimistic tail forecasts; cap final 5 days at 1.2x recent 10-day average.
